Subject: Workshop — interactive lab & exec highlight requests

Hi Neha,

We loved the outline you shared for the hands-on workshop next month. Two quick asks from our side as we finalize attendees: 

- Can you share a one-page executive summary / ‘spark notes’ that we can use in the invite so execs know the ROI focus?
- We need a 45-minute interactive lab flow that includes expected timings, required pre-reqs for participants, and a short troubleshooting checklist for room tech.

Do you have versions of those assets we can review by Friday (5/22)? If possible, please also include a short customer case snippet we can paste into the event page.

Thanks — we want to lock the attendee list early this week.

Best,
Lisa Huang
Head of Events, Crestline Analytics
lisa@crestline.ai

Marissa / Rachel / Marcus —

Thanks Lisa — happy to own a concise package. Proposed split of work (quick):

1) Marissa: Exec Spark Notes + 250-word case snippet (Crestline-focused). Goal: one PDF page, very scannable (metrics first).
2) Rachel: Workshop flow PPT (slide-by-slide timeline) and a single-slide troubleshooting checklist for AV/VM settings and network caveats.
3) Marcus: Short facilitator script for the 45-minute lab (speaker cues + 2 optional challenge scenarios).

Deadline: can we get drafts to Lisa and me by EOD Friday (5/22) so they can close invites? I can assemble and do a quick copy edit.

Lisa — FYI team will share drafts this week. If there are must-have data points you want in the case snippet, send them now (or reply-all).

Team / Lisa —

Attached drafts below. Key notes:

- exec_spark_notes_v1.pdf (attached): 1 page, top-line outcomes (30% reduction in inference cost, 2x throughput on representative workload). I marked two optional data points where Crestline can swap in their own numbers.
- crestline_case_brief.docx (attached): 250-word customer snippet (permission language included).
- workshop_flow_v3.pptx (shared link): slide deck with minute-by-minute flow + facilitator cues. I included two mini-challenges (A/B latency tuning and batch sizing) that can be dropped to shorten the session to 30 min.

Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEXAMPLEdriveid — all files uploaded (v1).

Open questions for Lisa/Marcus:
- Do we want participant laptops pre-loaded with a requirement (SDK + test dataset), or should it be purely cloud-hosted? The deck assumes cloud-hosted to avoid laptop config issues.
- Accessibility needs / captioning for exec reel? We can produce a transcript quickly if needed.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — Marissa nailed the one-pager and case snippet. A few quick confirmations before we finalize for the invite:

- Delivery format: we will run the lab cloud-hosted (no laptop installs). Rachel has a short AV checklist slide for the room (network whitelist + projector resolution).
- Exec Spark Notes will go in the invite; the top KPI is a conservative 20–30% cost reduction estimate. Lisa, please confirm if you want us to keep the Crestline-specific numbers or use the more generic language.
- Marcus — please finalize facilitator script with the 2 challenge scenarios short enough to keep Q&A time (slide notes call out where to skip).

If Lisa confirms badge language by EOD today we can hand final assets to Crestline for the invite.

Neha
